add_task_prompt.description: Send a follow-up prompt to an existing Manus task to continue the conversation or give the agent new instructions.
add_task_prompt.display_str_template: Add a prompt to Manus task '{0}'.
add_task_prompt.name: add_task_prompt

parameters.description: The Manus task ID, for example 'task_abc123'. Use the 'Create task' action's output to get it, or copy it from the task URL in the Manus app.
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.description: The follow-up instruction to send to the task, for example 'Now format the results as a table.'
parameters.name: prompt

parameters.description: Optional. Which Manus agent profile to run. Leave blank to use your account's default.
parameters.name: agent_profile

add_task_prompt.result_str_template: Sent a prompt to Manus task '{0}'.

task_id.description: The ID of the task the prompt was sent to.

create_task.description: Start a new Manus task from a prompt. The task runs asynchronously; use the returned task ID with the other actions to add prompts, check its status, or delete it.
create_task.name: create_task

parameters.description: The instruction for Manus to work on, for example 'Research the top 5 CRM tools and summarize their pricing.'
parameters.name: prompt

parameters.description: Optional custom title for the task. If left blank, Manus generates one from the prompt.
parameters.name: title

parameters.description: Optional. Which Manus agent profile to run. Leave blank to use your account's default.
parameters.name: agent_profile

share_url.description: Public share URL for the task, if shared.

share_visibility.description: Sharing visibility: private, team, or public.

task_url.description: URL to open the task in the Manus app.

delete_task.description: Permanently delete a Manus task. This cannot be undone. Agent-related tasks cannot be deleted, and a task that is still running must be stopped from the Manus app first.
delete_task.name: delete_task

parameters.description: The Manus task ID, for example 'task_abc123'. Use the 'Create task' action's output to get it, or copy it from the task URL in the Manus app.
parameters.name: task_id

deleted.description: True when the task was deleted.

id.description: The ID of the deleted task.

get_task.description: Retrieve a Manus task's current status and metadata, such as whether it is still running, its title, and how many credits it has used.
get_task.name: get_task

parameters.description: The Manus task ID, for example 'task_abc123'. Use the 'Create task' action's output to get it, or copy it from the task URL in the Manus app.
parameters.name: task_id

agent_profile.description: The agent profile the task runs on.

created_by_api_key.description: The API key that created the task (id and name), if any.

credit_usage.description: Credits the task has consumed so far.

share_visibility.description: Sharing visibility: private, team, or public.

status.description: Task status: running, stopped, waiting, or error.

task_type.description: Task type, e.g. standard, project, or agent_subtask.

task_url.description: URL to open the task in the Manus app.

description: Create and manage Manus AI agent tasks: start a task from a prompt, send follow-up prompts, check a task's status, and delete tasks.
